estimates.anchor_source: NO_EXTERNAL_ANCHOR. No tradable market (Polymarket/Kalshi fetched 2026-09-17T03:41:48Z). The revision-1 anchor (C05 at 0.27) was another forecast from this run, stale and not independent of the run's disclosure priors (A11-08); withdrawn. Sibling comparison: C05 revision 2 P(any quantification of the bundle at 5 Nov) = 0.28, a backward-looking figure for an existing product at one print. Three-estimate requirement unmet; the decomposition is a judgmental elicitation (A11-22).
estimates.conventions: letter or call only (conferences excluded); explicit figure or bound required (order-of-magnitude phrases excluded); forward and tied to 2027; revenue converts to GBV at 13.4% only for booking-generating products (an explicit 2027 revenue figure >= $135M qualifies); pure take-rate or advertising revenue (seller services, sponsored listings) does not convert

model.structure: judgmental elicitation: P(named) 0.92 x [1 - (1-0.035)(1-0.10)] = 0.121 (explicit-figure, booking-generating-revenue convention), rounded to 0.13 toward the Feb-class Laplace 0.125 and the regime class 0.21; lenient route adds P(named) x P(order-of-magnitude phrase) 0.45 x P(counted) 0.25 on the residual -> 0.212

impact.note: Immaterial (EV ~ +$0.5/share; ~0 under the fixed-multiple channel). Taken at face value a quantified >= 1pt lever adds ~$158M of FY27 revenue (1% of FY27 line-build revenue; $143M on the FY26 base); +$66M of flex EBITDA less $100-125M of launch opex (half of FY25's $200-250M) nets FY27 EBITDA -$34M to -$59M, margin -0.55 to -0.71pp (34.01-34.09% vs 34.64%), EPS -$0.05 to -$0.08. Stock: growth credit +$4.90 (1pt of FY27 nights, joint solve) less -$1.40 (net EBITDA -$46M at ~18x over 590m shares) = +$3.5. Keep one clause in the memo: management may name a 2027 lever but has never put a forward number on one, and a launch year costs margin before it adds revenue.
